revenue.label: Revenue and other income

other_income.note: Not separately printed: 'Other' (1,213) is labelled 'Other revenue/income' and combines FF marketing revenue, contract work revenue, property revenue and other; it is already inside 'revenue' above, so not repeated here.

employees.note: No group headcount/FTE total printed in the 2015 Annual Report (only an FTE reduction of 4,000 under the transformation program, pdf p.16). Likely in the separate Annual Review / data book, not used.

australian_revenue_share.label: Australia
australian_revenue_share.note: Note 3(F)(i) (printed p.60): net passenger and freight revenue Australia 10,586 of total net passenger and freight revenue 14,603; other revenue/income 1,213 not allocated; total revenue and other income 15,816. Attributed by point of sale.

checks.income_statement_identity: 15,816 (revenue and other income) - 14,768 (sum of listed expense lines incl. 40 share of equity-accounted loss, 28 impairment, 0 CGU impairment) + 90 (finance income) - 349 (finance costs) = 789 vs printed PBT 789.

issues: Single 'Revenue and other income' total; other income not separable from other revenue.
Expenses by nature; no cost of sales or materials line. 'Fuel' used as nearest consumables line (classification choice).
Note 4 footnote 3: 2014 comparatives restated (selling/marketing and employee assumption changes reclassified); current-year 2015 values used as originally reported.
